```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
songs <- read_csv("/Users/lehiwawong-frank/Desktop/dashboards/songs_normalize.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
songs <- read_csv("songs_normalize.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2019) |>
  mutate(
    duration_min = round(duration_ms / 60000, 2),
    genre = na_if(genre, "set()"),
    genre = replace_na(genre, "Unknown"),
    primary_genre = str_trim(str_split_i(genre, ",", 1)),
    is_zero_popularity = popularity == 0
  )

yearly_trends <- songs |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    avg_danceability = mean(danceability, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_energy = mean(energy, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_tempo = mean(tempo, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_duration = mean(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    song_count = n()
  )

```

### Row #1 {height=160px}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total Hit Songs (2000–2019)"
list(icon = "music-note-beamed", color = "primary", value = paste0(format(nrow(songs), big.mark = ","), " songs"))

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Average Song Length"
list(icon = "clock", color = "info", value = paste0(round(mean(songs$duration_min), 2), " min"))

```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Average Tempo"
list(icon = "speedometer2", color = "success", value = paste0(round(mean(songs$tempo), 0), " BPM"))

```

### Row #2{height=450px} Danceability & Energy Over Time

```{r}
p1 <- yearly_trends |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(avg_danceability, avg_energy), names_to = "metric", values_to = "score") |>
  mutate(metric = recode(metric, avg_danceability = "Danceability", avg_energy = "Energy")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = score, color = metric)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Score (0–1)", color = "Feature") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p1)

```

### Row #3 Track Length (Minutes) Over Time

```{r}
p2 <- ggplot(yearly_trends, aes(x = year, y = avg_duration)) +
  geom_line(color = "#1DB954", linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(color = "#1DB954", size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Average Duration (Minutes)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p2)

```

### Row #4 {height=450px} Tempo by Top Genres

```{r}
top_genres <- songs |>
  count(primary_genre, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 6) |>
  pull(primary_genre)

p3 <- songs |>
  filter(primary_genre %in% top_genres) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(primary_genre, tempo, median), y = tempo, fill = primary_genre)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Primary Genre", y = "Tempo (BPM)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p3)

```
